definitions.explanation: Rare, naturally occurring metallic elements with high economic value, such as gold, silver, and platinum. Also used to refer to jewelry and accessories made from these metals.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Gold is one of the precious metals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a jewelry store in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}される→左右される：26073_sayuusareru⟧。
examples.english: Precious metal prices are greatly influenced by global economic trends.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {貴|き} (precious, noble) + ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧ (metal). Refers both to the metals themselves (gold, silver, platinum, palladium) and to the jewelry industry. {貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ is a common term for a jewelry store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (jewelry store)
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買取|かいとり}→買取：14366_kaitori⟧ (purchasing of precious metals)
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}⟦{相場|そうば}→相場：07668_souba⟧ (precious metals market price)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧: gemstone, jewel — precious stones rather than metals
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧: metal — the general term for metals
